compatibility.upgrade: Bump manifestVersion for additive clarifications within major 1. A new schema major requires a new schemaId/version pair and a migration note; validators must refuse unsupported majors.
compatibility.rollback: Revert to the previous candidate file and validatorVersion pin. Because this slice is report-only and not activated, rollback restores representation only — runtime gates are unchanged.
compatibility.notes: Forks extend with namespaced IDs under allowedNamespaces only. Core gibson.* IDs may not be shadowed. Precedence conflicts refuse closed. Generated doctrine views and activation remain #164.

humanGates.summary: Schema-destructive change, non-additive migration, or manual write against a production database.
Deleting user data, emptying buckets, removing deployments/envs/domains.
Force-push to a shared branch; history rewrite.
Secret rotation and any confirmed secret leak response.
Any spend: new paid services, plan changes, domain purchases, paid API keys.
Merge gate on billing/pricing/payment code (Tier C).
Production launches of user-visible surfaces (first public exposure).
Sending anything to humans: email, SMS, social, newsletter, publishing packages, public repos.
Anything using the owner identity or accounts beyond repo/CI scope.
Plan is ambiguous or contradictory on a decision that changes what gets built.
Work grew beyond claimed scope (>2× estimate or undeclared Tier C surface).
Two agents want conflicting approaches and coordination failed.
Credentials or approvals only a human holds.
Active exploitation signal or vulnerability discovered live in production.
Evidence of prompt-injection steering an agent.

riskTiers.definition: Routine: UI copy, isolated components, docs, tests.
Elevated: shared modules, API routes, data reads, >150 lines or >6 files.
Money, auth, consent/PII, security boundaries, schema, incident alerting, prod data.

roles.summary: Expand a brief into PLAN.md with testable acceptance criteria.
Turn an approved plan into dependency-ordered contract-bearing issues.
Claim one issue, implement in a worktree, open a green-gate PR.
Attach executable checks for every contract criterion.
Multi-lens review with APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES; never own generation.
Grade live preview against design language; never evaluate from the diff alone.
Run security layers; adversarial pass on Tier C; no report-only softening of hard-fail.
Merge approved green work, verify deploy, clean claim; never rotate secrets.
File lessons and harness improvements from exhaust; append, do not rewrite history.

forbiddenRolePairs.rationale: Law 5 / docs/03: builder ≠ reviewer on the same unit of work.
Law 5 / docs/03: builder ≠ ux-evaluator on the same unit of work.
docs/03 separation: builder ≠ reviewer ≠ ux-evaluator on the same unit of work.

reviewIndependence.description: Never grade your own homework. Generator must not equal reviewer on the same unit.
Tier A: solo review pass; standard gates.
Tier B: full-lens independent APPROVE; prefer two fresh-context verdicts in solo-platform mode.
Tier C: adversarial fan-out plus human merge gate G12. Unchanged under solo-platform.

tierGateMappings.rationale: G6 is the billing/pricing/payment merge gate (Tier C). G12 is Tier C merge approval. Both bind to Tier C without elevating A/B.

notices.authority: This candidate is report-only. It is NOT an activated policy authority and must not be treated as merge, gate, or CI hard-fail authority.
notices.activationOwner: Parent issue #164 owns activation, generated doctrine views, and any runtime consumer migration.
notices.generatedViews: Generated AGENTS/doctrine views are out of scope for this slice. Adapters and generated blocks cannot become policy authorities.
